crop.notes: The Allen 'Sporting Notes' notice at top, followed by an unrelated 'Army Orders' item.

ocr.notes: Allen notice read correctly apart from 'G19' for 619; Army Orders text has scattered errors.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's sporting notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, October 6, 1891, page 4.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as the place of the "retired champion pugilist of the world," with a free concert every evening

notes: A recurring paid reading notice placed under 'Sporting Notes', not a news item.
